notes.text: You can now use IN mapping to pass parameter values from the entity to a parameterized value help entity set
You can now define visible and enabled properties for table standard actions via manifest
You can now specify that personalization changes are not persisted using the ignorePersonalizationChanges property in the Chart building block
You can now set predefined values for filter fields in the filter bar and Adapt Filters dialog
We've resolved an issue where create:mandatory and update:readonly fields were incorrectly displayed as read-only in tables with creationMode set to inlineCreationRows or EmptyRow
You can now specify that personalization changes are not persisted using the ignorePersonalizationChanges property in the Table building block
You can now define filter fields for which user default parameters are applied in a filter bar variant
RadioButtons building block now correctly evaluates editable and enabled expressions in tables
